current_state_evidence.observation: Production assembly selects exactly one configured chat and embedding provider, attaches health lifecycle, public limits, same-origin web, and pure-ASGI response headers.
One limit permit and bundle handle bound retrieval, embedding, provider generation, validation, shared deadline, and cooperative cancellation.
Complete buffered model output is converted to validated text and backend-owned immutable citations or localized abstention.

control_flow.failure_path: Selected provider remains safely unavailable; no cloud, model, or adapter fallback is constructed.
Pre-stream failures use common JSON; post-start failure has one error terminal; disconnect emits no response.

control_flow.path: React App -> profile/status/chat SSE -> semantic DOM and CharacterRenderer
control_flow.failure_path: Setup/offline/error remain accessible and profile content remains usable without leaking server configuration.

interfaces.contract: Typed complete-output chat and normalized embedding results, safe health/failure categories, bounded timeouts, exact identity, and no fallback.
Model emits request-local evidence IDs only; backend validates support and constructs immutable GitHub SHA URLs.
Validated success emits metadata, token, optional citations, complete; started failure emits exactly one error and never complete.

lifecycle.rule: Only configured adapters are polled and published to safe public readiness.
Limits precede provider cost; timeout/disconnect bound accepted work and release resources.
Application events choose state; the renderer remains presentational and reduced motion pins frame zero.

state_transitions.transition: complete provider result -> validated delivery -> SSE
state_transitions.forbidden: provider token or URL reaches the browser before backend validation

state_transitions.transition: accepted request -> http.disconnect -> cancellation signal and silent ASGI completion
state_transitions.forbidden: response bytes or new provider stage after disconnect
clearing or translating existing conversation history

failure_boundaries.safe_result: Stable safe provider error and degraded readiness without fallback or secret/private URL exposure.
Unknown IDs, URLs, HTML, unsupported material/person claims, or inference cycles become citation-free abstention.
Timeout is safe JSON before streaming; disconnect ends the ASGI request without response; started internal failure emits one error.
Payload, IP, daily, and global concurrency rejection occurs before embedding or generation.

invariants.statement: OpenAI-compatible, Ollama, and local runtime embedding paths obey one safe typed contract, exact provider selection, bounded retry/deadline, readiness lifecycle, and no silent fallback.
invariants.enforcement_owner: ProviderRuntime, concrete adapters, production assembly, and provider contract/integration tests
invariants.prohibited_behavior: An Ollama/local failure constructs or calls a cloud adapter, reflects a secret/private URL, retries another adapter, or publishes ready.
invariants.counterexample: Configure Ollama/local, booby-trap cloud constructors, fail local health, and observe any cloud construction or ready state.

invariants.statement: Only fully validated evidence-backed material is published; citations resolve to reviewed evidence and backend-owned immutable locations; unsupported and unasserted person claims fail closed.
invariants.enforcement_owner: validate_answer, GroundedChatService, deterministic scenario scorer, and grounding security tests
invariants.prohibited_behavior: Unknown evidence, model URL/HTML, uncited material, unrelated owner assertion, or inference cycle reaches the visitor as supported content.
invariants.counterexample: Cite an unrelated OWNER_ASSERTION for 'Alice founded the company' or emit an extra unreviewed citation and obtain a supported answer/perfect score.

invariants.statement: Public chat has stable validated SSE terminals, correlated safe diagnostics, one overall deadline, cost-before-work admission, and silent bounded disconnect cancellation.
invariants.enforcement_owner: pure-ASGI public boundary, chat_stream, ChatLimits, GroundedChatService, and direct-ASGI integration probes
invariants.prohibited_behavior: Unvalidated partial output, complete after error, response after disconnect, fresh per-stage deadline, or provider work before rejection.
invariants.counterexample: Send body then immediate http.disconnect while answer blocks and observe an unfinished ASGI task or any response bytes.

invariants.statement: The same-origin visitor is responsive, bilingual, semantic, keyboard/named-control accessible, reduced-motion aware, citation safe, and preserves conversation across locale changes.
invariants.enforcement_owner: React semantic DOM, typed SSE client, CharacterRenderer, web gates, and real Edge browser probes
invariants.prohibited_behavior: Horizontal mobile overflow, unnamed controls, unsafe mutable citation, locale-history loss, animation under reduced motion, console/network errors, or stale document language.
invariants.counterexample: Populate chat at 390px, switch locale, and observe overflow, lost turns, unsafe citation rel/href, wrong html lang, or animated nonzero frame under reduced motion.

invariants.statement: Provider secrets/private URLs remain server-only and production frontend/API remain same-origin with restrictive security headers and safe logs/errors.
invariants.enforcement_owner: environment assembly, provider transports, pure-ASGI response middleware, same-origin app, and security regression tests
invariants.prohibited_behavior: Secret/private URL in browser, bundle, public error/log, broad CORS, missing CSP/nosniff, or redirect-based origin escape.
invariants.counterexample: Inject a secret/private URL canary into provider failure and find it in public response, browser build, log, or Edge console/network output.

invariants.statement: Final Phase 3 status is supported by current aggregate, browser, Docker, fresh evaluator, hygiene, and canonical Foreman artifacts without rewriting historical failures.
invariants.enforcement_owner: Main integration record, append-only closure ledger, Foreman validator, and project memory
invariants.prohibited_behavior: Calling Phase 3 verified with a failed/not-run blocker or converting the historical attribution-limited delta guard to pass.
invariants.counterexample: Remove the Docker/fresh evaluator artifact or mark the old GATE-DELTA passed and still validate closure.
